propositions: The planning corpus size assertion (PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE = 113) is pinned to a count but re-derived from live ticket state at runtime, causing false failures when tickets are reclassified or prefix resolution changes.
The corpus drift from 113 to 114 is caused by post-pin ticket reclassifications and new commits that change bug-ticket prefix resolution, undetected because no CI or test suite runs the check script.
The fix pins the corpus by commit SHA identity (PLANNING_CORPUS_COMMITS frozenset of 113 exact SHAs) rather than re-deriving count from live state, making the check immune to tracker churn.

Per-row ticket labels remain best-effort artifact metadata for reporting only and no longer gate the check; only commit identity and flagged-set membership (== ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE) are assertions.
